verdict.rationale: Cake documents a dedicated My Cake Portal where employees and investors view their individual holdings, and admins control what they see, so a personal employee portal clearly exists. The evidence does not show the portal displaying vesting progress, strike price, or outcome or exit value modeling for employees; the round modeling it does document is an admin-side dilution tool. Missing for 10: evidence of vesting progress in the employee portal, strike price display, employee-facing scenario or exit value modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes

citations.quote: the My Cake Portal where investors and employees view their individual holdings
As an admin, you control exactly what they can see, they do not have access to your full cap table.
